description: Register localized cloud commands and persistent state
notes: Will implement the extension entrypoint and state persistence together with the first command surface; starting the local plugin implementation now.

description: Build selectable submission and secret preflight
notes: Added preflight display/confirmation for environment, Git, and session artifacts before any upload; secrets remain an explicit empty authorization list until configured.

description: Upload incremental environment, Git, and session state
notes: Uploads manifest, deterministic Git snapshot, and native JSONL session archive as immutable artifacts, then submits a structured TaskSpec.

description: Route local input and display remote event streams
notes: Routes ordinary local input to remote task_input using Pi streaming behavior and displays remote cursor/status events in the Pi widget/status bar.

description: Add reconnect, abort, and restart recovery
notes: Added cloud-reconnect cursor resume command, persisted pairing state, durable live event entries, abort command, and shutdown socket cleanup.

description: Review and safely apply Git result artifacts
notes: Added baseline-checked Git snapshot result application with path traversal protection and a review selector.

description: Synthesize and switch to merged native session
notes: Added native session merge command using existing entry/parentId validation and Pi switchSession after atomic JSONL synthesis.

description: Add sponsor entry, cleanup, and extension tests
notes: Added bilingual cloud command strings, sponsor placeholder command, cleanup behavior, client-state/result tests, and extension command registration coverage.
